metadata.provenance: Byte-exact, independently reproducible canonical ELD goldens. Every golden file and every SHA-256 is computed by the real pipeline (elang_eld::parse -> inventory::from_document -> canon::to_string); no digest is hand-written. The authored input.eld sources are deliberately non-canonical so the goldens exercise the ordering rules rather than merely echoing the input (steering §0.3; ADR 0003).

vectors.name: minimal-inventory
vectors.description: Smallest valid inventory: one `phonemes` root, one consonants group, one vowels group, one root each (REQ-CANON-001, REQ-CANON-002).

vectors.name: group-order
vectors.description: Groups are emitted `consonants`, `vowels`, then custom groups in ASCII bytewise name order regardless of declaration order (REQ-CANON-001).

vectors.name: root-order
vectors.description: Roots within a group are sorted by authored NFC IPA UTF-8 bytes (REQ-CANON-002).

vectors.name: allophone-order
vectors.description: Allophones within a root are sorted by authored NFC IPA UTF-8 bytes, bare and fielded forms alike (REQ-CANON-002).

vectors.name: bare-allophone
vectors.description: A fieldless allophone is emitted as a bare leaf node, never with an empty block (REQ-CANON-004).

vectors.name: condition-tree
vectors.description: Nested `group`/`or` trees keep their nesting and their condition children are sorted by the Canonical Condition Sorting Key v1 (REQ-CANON-005, REQ-CANON-006).

vectors.name: duplicate-predicates
vectors.description: Duplicate predicates and contradictory conditions are preserved verbatim — no Boolean simplification (REQ-CANON-006).

vectors.name: tie-bar-variant
vectors.description: The authored lower tie bar (U+035C) is preserved byte-for-byte; the tie-bar-folded comparison key is used for uniqueness only (REQ-CANON-006).

vectors.name: roman-case
vectors.description: Romanization case is preserved exactly as authored (REQ-CANON-006).

vectors.name: unicode-preserved
vectors.description: Permitted Unicode (combining diacritic, spacing modifier) is emitted directly as UTF-8 and never silently normalized (REQ-CANON-008).

vectors.name: condition-order
vectors.description: Condition children are emitted in canonical key order, not declaration order (REQ-CANON-005).

vectors.name: order-variant-a
vectors.description: Declaration-order variant A — identical canonical bytes to `order-variant-b` (REQ-CANON-009).

vectors.name: order-variant-b
vectors.description: Declaration-order variant B — identical canonical bytes to `order-variant-a` (REQ-CANON-009).
